title: NaviMed-UMB: hardware envelope studies for local AI deployment on consumer RDNA 4 GPUs

creators.name: Minarowski, Łukasz
creators.affiliation: Department of Respiratory Physiopathology, Medical University of Białystok, Poland

description:
NaviMed-UMB is an engineering log and reproducible benchmark suite for running open-weight large language models on a consumer dual AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 workstation (gfx1201, RDNA 4) under ROCm 7.2 and vLLM 0.19. It is the L1 (hardware envelope) pillar of a three-layer architecture for sovereign, on-premise medical AI. It provides a benchmark protocol, public engineering envelopes for a 21-model suite, AWQ W4A16 releases of the PLLuM family on Hugging Face (mozarcik/), and a Polish SmPC calibration corpus (mozarcik/clinical-pl-smpc-awq-calibration, no patient data).

Version 0.5.2 is a methodology-and-documentation release:

  • METHODOLOGY 1.9: power is the per-sample sum of the discrete GPUs, taken over the generation window; the Holm–Bonferroni family is the eight-point ladder including N = 1; Bielik #10 is the vendor-released SpeakLeash AWQ (revision 0de6dd1), not a precision pair.
  • METHODOLOGY 1.8: the cross-stack phase is moved to v0.7.
  • Every run records the kernel command line.
  • N = 1 gap-fill: both members of each precision pair are measured.
  • A companion Harness page (AMD fork of leChatonFat), outside the benchmark envelope.

Earlier versions: see RELEASES.md.

Per-N throughput, latency and power/energy-per-token figures are held under embargo (METHODOLOGY §11.2/§11.3) until peer-reviewed publication. Engineering envelopes, walltime, sanity-gate evidence and failure post-mortems are public (§11.1).

Intended audience: researchers building local AI infrastructure for privacy-sensitive data, RDNA 4 inference-framework maintainers, and clinical-AI groups evaluating Polish-language models.

AI assistance: generative-AI tools helped with documentation, code and analysis, including Claude Code, an agentic command-line tool that runs on the workstation under the author's supervision; no AI tool generated a measurement (see AI_USAGE_DISCLOSURE.md).
notes: AI assistance disclosure: this project is developed with generative-AI assistance (Anthropic Claude via claude.ai and the Claude Code agentic command-line tool; OpenAI GPT and Google Gemini via web apps; open-weight models served locally on the project's R9700 workstation for Polish-language proofreading). Claude Code runs on the measurement workstation under the author's supervision and, in some sessions, launched author-approved scripts and benchmark runs; no AI tool generated, estimated or interpolated a measurement.
